title: Lesson: Supplier lead time risk at G3 – Project Helios
content:
Project: Helios | Gate: G3 | Function: Procurement | Risk: Yes

WHAT HAPPENED
During the G3 review on Project Helios, supplier lead time confirmation for primary packaging was delayed by two weeks. Root cause: Procurement had not been informed early enough about the revised fill weight, which changed the packaging specification after supplier quotes had already been requested. Suppliers needed to re-quote, adding a two-week delay.

IMPACT
G4 milestone slipped by three weeks. Launch date pushed from September to October. Additional airfreight costs of ~€45K incurred to partially recover the timeline.

LESSON
Packaging specification must be frozen and communicated to Procurement at least four weeks before G3 gate review. Procurement should be a mandatory G3 attendee. Supplier lead time confirmation should be a gate entry criterion for G3, not a post-gate action.

RECOMMENDATION
Add supplier lead time confirmation to the G3 entry checklist as a hard gate requirement. Update the BLAST standards accordingly.
